description: This file defines the 'Policy' interface for access control, including methods for building, modifying, and serializing policy objects with entries, subjects, resources, and permissions within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: Policy.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines the JSON field definitions used for serializing and deserializing Policy objects

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new mutable builder for constructing an immutable Policy, either with a specific ID or default.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current Policy's entries for modification.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the optional entity ID of the Policy.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions, fixed to V_2.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with the Policy.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state of the Policy.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if the Policy has the specified lifecycle.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns all labels associated with this Policy.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the Policy contains an entry for the given label.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Sets a PolicyEntry into the Policy, replacing any existing for the same label.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyEntry for a given label.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes the PolicyEntry with the specified label.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific PolicyEntry instance.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Associates a Subjects object with a label, replacing previous subjects.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Associates a single Subject with a label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a subject by SubjectId from the Policy entry with the given label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a given Subject (by object) from the Policy entry with the given label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Associates Resources with a label, replacing previous resources.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Associates a Resource with a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource identified by resource type and path from a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource using its ResourceKey.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a Resource object from the Policy by its resource key.

methods.name: setEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets effected permissions for a specific resource key in a label.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Retrieves effected permissions for a subject ID on a resource type and path.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Retrieves effected permissions for a subject ID on a resource key.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the Policy has no entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the Policy.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a modifiable set of all Policy entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of Policy entries.

methods.name: toInlinedJson
methods.description: Serializes the Policy into a JSON object for embedding, using a predicate to filter fields.

methods.name: toInlinedJson
methods.description: Serializes the Policy into a JSON object for embedding, using a field selector.
